messages:
maya: We're seeing intermittent early stops on the int4 bring-up. Happens only with streaming and our chat_template that injects an extra </s> in assistant role.
ben: repro? minimal prompt?
maya: small repro: chat_template = {"system":"You are helpful", "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}], "stop": ["</s>"]} - model sometimes returns partial text then stream closes. Logs show `eos received` twice in quick succession.
li: could be tokenizer adding eos on encode + model emitting EOS. HF tokenizers often set `add_special_tokens=True` by default. Are we double-appending?
maya: yes, HF tokenizer has `eos_token_id=2` and also template appended `</s>` -> serialized token stream had two EOS tokens back-to-back.
sam: streaming runtime treats first EOS as termination and then discards rest. But the issue is race when batching: if two EOS tokens land in the same microbatch, our stop-detector fires on the first but still runs emitter which flushes early.
ben: can you paste the token ids and decoding snippet?
maya: log: `tokens: [101, 402, 2, 2, 5, 8] decode-> 'Hello </s> </s> how are'`
li: aha, duplicate eos in middle. For quantized kernels we observed weird kernel-level truncation when EOS repeated -> they collapse cache pointers.
sam: quick mitigation: in the streaming layer dedupe consecutive EOS tokens before applying stop logic. Patch:
```
if token_id == eos_id and last_token == eos_id:
    continue  # drop duplicate EOS
```

ben: sounds reasonable as hotfix. But we should also fix tokenizer mapping: set `tokenizer.encode(..., add_special_tokens=False)` for template merging. Add unit test in onboarding harness.
maya: will run regression tests: run evals across open-qa, summarization bench, and the convo-sim harness. Tagging @qa for coverage.
deploy-bot: Created ticket INFR-1123: "eos duplication causing premature stream close on int4 bringup". Assigned to maya, ben. ETA 48h.
li: longer-term: update HF->Redwood conversion to normalize `eos_token` handling in config.json and chat_templates; add conversion test for `eos_token_id` mapping and for `add_eos_token` flag.
sam: also check KV-cache offsets: duplicates can shift kv pointer decrement which caused stray writes in quant kernels last week.
maya: thanks — will attach traces + small repro script in ticket. sending now :mag:
